# ABINADWAN Plugins Suite

> An independent, MIT-licensed community plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It provides six independently toggleable components using native Harness services. It is not an official DeepSeek product.

Package: `@abinadwan/dsh-plugins-suite`. The suite ships ready-to-run JavaScript, uses Cordis and native DSH UI and service contracts, and does not require a separate application server. Model and provider compatibility depends on the installed Harness version and configured adapters.

Use published GitHub Releases as the source of truth for available stable versions. Install approved releases using their full 40-character Git commit SHA. The `main` branch is the reviewed release-source branch; `develop` is the integration branch and may contain unreleased changes. Match documentation and code to the revision actually installed. A version bump or passing CI is not a published release or proof of full Desktop acceptance.

## Getting started

- [Project README](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/README.md): Overview, supported installation, updates and development.
- [Published releases](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/releases): Authoritative release notes and published versions.
- [Component details](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md): Capabilities, defaults, limitations and compatibility.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/README.md): Documentation navigation.
- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): Upstream host project.

## Components

- [Environment & Context](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#environment--context): Read-only environment and session inspector, including estimated context and token usage; does not enforce token budgets or provide authoritative billing.
- [Humanizer](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#humanizer): Native runtime Skill for explicit prose editing; no dedicated rewriting service or guaranteed detector evasion.
- [My Profile](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#my-profile): Native Profile settings, response preferences, personal context and JSON backup/restore. Consult the installed revision's privacy rules before sharing data.
- [Direct Chat](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#direct-chat): Distinct native chat Sessions within one shared Workspace, with tool-denial policies; not a filesystem or process sandbox.
- [Archive Manager](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#chat-control): Authorized archive browsing, search, scoped protection and native restore; not a global access-control boundary or automatic cleanup service.
- [Adaptive Reasoning](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/docs/DETAIL.md#adaptive-reasoning): Manual supported reasoning-effort selection, opt-in local recommendations and aggregate statistics; no automatic effort application or global token budget enforcement.

## Security and limitations

- [Security policy](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Data handling, disclosure, update checks, security boundaries and vulnerability reporting.
- [License](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT license.
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/abinadwan/DSH-ABINADWAN-Plugins-Suite/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): Attribution and bundled third-party content.

My Profile settings and JSON backups are not encrypted by the suite. Data sent to a selected local or cloud provider follows that provider's handling; disabling components does not erase saved data or earlier disclosures. Update checks contact public GitHub endpoints; installation updates require user confirmation and use the native Host updater. Do not infer full sandboxing, universal privacy enforcement, guaranteed rollback or universal provider support.

## Documentation maintenance

Review this file with every project modification or improvement. Update affected descriptions, links, compatibility, security/privacy boundaries, release references and verification claims in the same change whenever they change. Record an explicit no-impact review when no factual update is needed. Keep this index consistent with the authoritative documentation and code. Do not present proposed features or unverified tests as implemented or passed. The v1.2.0 Humanizer Studio candidate nine-service engine, owner-only HTTP module and Studio panel (feature-branch implementation, verification pending) and phase 3.7 update/CI hardening on its feature branch are unreleased; consult its draft PR and CI for evidence, not as a statement of shipped capabilities. The development-only Studio contract records native admission, middleware visibility and retention limits.
